about: The epistola of the formulary “Nativity of Saint John the Baptist” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Hear, O islands, and give heed, you peoples from afar: the Lord called me from the womb; from my mother’s womb He remembered my name. And He made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of His hand He protected me, and He made me like a chosen arrow; in His quiver He hid me. And He said to me: You are My servant, Israel, for in you I will glory. And now says the Lord, who formed me from the womb to be His servant: Behold, I have given you as a light of the nations, that you may be My salvation to the farthest end of the earth. Kings shall see, and princes shall rise up and worship, because of the Lord and the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you.
